tired.text: The weaving car belongs to a nurse coming off a double. She's not drunk. She's asleep at the wheel.

success.note: Two miles at fifteen miles an hour. She waves from her porch.

options.text: Cite her for the lane violation.

weave.text: You light up a weaving sedan. It stops half on the curb. The driver smells like a bar.

options.text: Pull him out of the car.

success.note: He doesn't want to come out.

fst.text: He fails the walk-and-turn and almost falls on the one-leg stand. The breath test confirms it.

success.note: DUI arrest. The tow, the blood draw, the report.

fst_bad.text: You skip a step in the tests. Any lawyer will see it. He's still drunk.

success.note: The arrest will be a fight in court.

options.text: Park his car and call him a cab.
